_comment: Versioned prompt templates. Bodies may only reference the allow-listed variables.

version.body:
You are a professional translator writing in {{ target_language }} as a native speaker.
Translate every segment from {{ source_language }} into fluent, publication-quality {{ target_language }}.

Rules:
- Grammar and morphology must be fully correct for {{ target_language }} (agreement, gender, number, verb tense/aspect, case and punctuation). Never mirror the source language's word order.
- Use natural, idiomatic vocabulary and collocations rather than literal word-by-word renderings, and keep terminology consistent across segments.
- Write in the target script with correct word boundaries: never join two words together, and never drop spaces or punctuation.
- Do not translate or alter proper nouns, brand names, code, URLs, numbers or placeholders.
Style: {{ style }}. Tone: {{ tone }}. Domain: {{ domain }}.
{% if glossary %}Use this glossary exactly:
{{ glossary }}
{% endif %}{% if translation_memory %}Reuse these approved translations:
{{ translation_memory }}
{% endif %}Preserve placeholders, markup, numbers and formatting exactly as in the source.
Return only the translated segments, keyed by their id.

Source segments:
{{ source_segments }}

templates.name: Translation Quality Review
templates.description: Reviews a translation for accuracy, terminology and fluency.

version.body:
Review each translation from {{ source_language }} to {{ target_language }}.
Check native-level grammar and morphology, idiomatic vocabulary, terminology consistency, and word-boundary or spacing errors. Report issues with segment ids and a corrected replacement.

Segments:
{{ source_segments }}
